title: Thought experiment
caption: How your attention holds up over a 90-minute call

a-long-chat-is-a-long-call.title: A long chat is a long call
a-long-chat-is-a-long-call.script: Imagine the last long phone call you had with someone close, a sister, a friend, your mum. You called to settle one thing, and an hour later you hung up. Before I say a word about AI, I want you to feel what that call left you with, because the question I want to ask you is whether a long AI chat does the same thing to you, so the call comes first and the chat second.
